candidate_status: Awaiting Tom's review · used in the family release

blender.animation_keys: Every frame, linear, exported without keyframe optimisation
blender.skin: One skin; rigid props plus smoothstep blends at the neck, waist, shoulders, elbows, hips, knees, ankles and tuft chains (at most 2 influences used)
blender.root: Identity, fixed floor-centred root; no root animation; the hips carry the bounce, lean, lunge and bow
blender.bind_pose: Right arm in the sheet A-pose holding the planted cane (the sheet pose), left arm its mirror, head straight, feet toed out 12 deg (rest controls reproduce it, max matrix error 8.6e-06)
blender.sheet_pose: Idle at 0 s reproduces the blockout sheet pose (cane tip, grip, mic centre, waving wrist and ankles within 6.2e-07 m)

export.glow_material: Principled BSDF with the atlas linked to both Base Color and Emission Color, Emission Strength 1.0 (glTF emissiveTexture = the same image, emissiveFactor [1,1,1]; no KHR_materials_emissive_strength)
export.compression: None; no Draco, Meshopt or KTX2 requirement

preview.source: Exact delivered GLB via Three.js GLTFLoader
preview.renderer: Chromium headless ANGLE SwiftShader, real WebGL raster; no physical device claim
preview.stills_pose: Main stills: idle at 0 s (the sheet pose); rest-*.png: the bind pose; dark-*.png: a dim casino-room rig (hemisphere 0.12, key lights at 5%) to show the emissive eyes, bulb, halo and burst
preview.lighting: Warm hemisphere plus three directional lights; ACES tone mapping exposure 1.0
